purpose: Fail-closed contract for validating future fresh-player telemetry evidence without activating collection or substituting metrics for Human review.
required_session_invariants: session_start is first and occurs exactly once
session_end is last and occurs at most once
session_id, level_id, and build_id provenance remain session-consistent
elapsed_ms is integer >= 0 and monotonic nondecreasing
first_action occurs at most once and precedes later vehicle_action/failure/retry/level_complete events
evidence_role: Future telemetry files may support external-playtest/release analysis only after authorization. This contract is preproduction QA and authorizes no instrumentation, endpoint, publishing, or gate PASS.
